detail.title: Institutional and Error-Correction Mechanisms in Information Persistence
detail.summary: This research journal entry synthesizes findings on the persistence of information, acknowledging the duality between physical entropy and institutional preservation. Work continues to focus on how error-correction mechanisms—both technical and social—differentiate information that decays from that which persists. The research mission remains consistent with established frontiers, treating information survival as a primary operational objective.

children.title: Review and synthesize the role of formal error detection as a requisite for institutional information survival…

detail.reason: Information persistence depends on error correction. Since the current active project is information_survival, and institutional persistence relies on maintaining information integrity, bridging this to the error-detection framework is logical.
